name: Scoring Rubric for Bat Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of bat illustration. Focuses on inverted perspective understanding, web symbolism, and text-image relationship.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of visual inversion as metaphor, understanding of web as ambivalent symbol, and interpretation of text as commentary on image.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the upside-down posture as visual metaphor for different perspective?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of inverted perspective, understands its relationship to nocturnal vision, and connects to story themes of alternative truth.
AI recognizes inversion as meaningful and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices inversion but analysis is superficial or literal.
AI treats posture as random or fails to see significance.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive the web as ambivalent symbol (both trap and protection)?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies web's ambivalence, understands its relationship to entrapment in nocturnal vision, and connects to themes of safety and imprisonment.
AI recognizes web as symbolic and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices web but analysis is one-dimensional (only trap).
AI treats web as mere decoration or misses its significance.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the relationship between text (night beauty, morning unsuitable) and image (woman in web)?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of text-image relationship, understands how text comments on image (what's not shown), and interprets brackets '[UŽ]' as meaningful.
AI recognizes relationship and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices connection but analysis is superficial.
AI treats text and image as separate or misinterprets their relation.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (bat, flight, morning light) and presence (inverted woman, web, text) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of what's not shown, and analyzes selective representation as emphasis on state over event.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct inverted perspective from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about spatial relationships?
overall_assessment_guidance: The bat illustration particularly tests understanding of visual inversion and ambivalent symbolism. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding inverted perspective and ambivalent symbolism.
